approved_assumptions: The model API host is the one permitted model-plane egress destination; content in READ_SET can leave inside model requests to that service (§6.4, §11).
The worker holds the harness OAuth token in its synthetic home because the CLI has no external auth broker; the egress allowlist bounds where it can be presented (§11).
The diff secret scan of §6.5a(iv) protects only what reaches GitHub; it is not a mitigation for content exposed in model requests.
The quota gate makes overshoot visible and refuses the next start; it never prevents a single step's overshoot (§3.4).
The #141 non-author-CODEOWNER ceremony is unsatisfiable with a single CODEOWNER; .adlc/config.json lands by deliberate admin merge (§0).
scripts/preflight.mjs gates run gate by gate in a sandbox until R13 lands (§6.6).
Five spec-review residuals are enforced as build-ticket AC2–AC6 rather than as spec prose.

An operator-requested remote branch delete cannot be made atomic against a concurrent pull-request creation; the window is bounded by ref-too-fresh, a 120 s post-delete grace loop and 24 h of per-iteration re-checks, and repaired by the lease-guarded restore of §2.1a; a pull request opened after the last re-check is the residual.
